1: // Simple side‑scrolling game based on IDEA.md
2: // Canvas with id "game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   // Audio setup
6:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
7:   // Ensure the context is running after user interaction
8:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
9:   window.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, { once: true });
10: 
11:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
12:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
15:     oscillator.frequency.value = freq;
16:     oscillator.connect(gain);
17:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
19:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
20:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration);
22:     oscillator.start(now);
23:     oscillator.stop(now + duration);
24:   }
25: 
26:   // Rest of the game code
27:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
28:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
29:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
30:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
31:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
32:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
33: 
34:   // Game settings
35:   const shipSize = 30;
36:   const debrisSize = 20;
37:   const asteroidSize = 40;
38:   const maxDebris = 5;
39:   const maxAsteroids = 3;
40:   const gameDuration = 60; // seconds
41: 
42:   // State
43:   let score = 0;
44:   let timeLeft = gameDuration;
45:   let gameOver = false;
46: 
47:   const ship = { x: 50, y: height / 2 - shipSize / 2, w: shipSize, h: shipSize, dy: 0 };
48:   const debris = [];
49:   const asteroids = [];
50:   const stars = [];
51: 
52:   // generate background stars
53:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
54:     stars.push({
55:       x: Math.random() * width,
56:       y: Math.random() * height,
57:       size: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
58:       speed: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.5,
59:     });
60:   }
61: 
62:   // Input handling
63:   const keys = {};
64:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
65:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
66: 
67:   function spawnDebris() {
68:     if (debris.length >= maxDebris) return;
69:     const y = Math.random() * (height - debrisSize);
70:     debris.push({ x: width, y, w: debrisSize, h: debrisSize, speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
71:   }
72: 
73:   function spawnAsteroid() {
74:     if (asteroids.length >= maxAsteroids) return;
75:     const y = Math.random() * (height - asteroidSize);
76:     // generate a simple polygon for visual variety
77:     const points = [];
78:     const sides = 6 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
79:     const radius = asteroidSize / 2;
80:     for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
81:       const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / sides;
82:       const r = radius * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.3);
83:       points.push({ x: Math.cos(angle) * r, y: Math.sin(angle) * r });
84:     }
85:     asteroids.push({ x: width, y, w: asteroidSize, h: asteroidSize, speed: 3 + Math.random() * 2, points });
86:   }
87: 
88:   function rectsOverlap(a, b) {
89:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
90:   }
91: 
92:   function update(dt) {
93:     // ship movement
94:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.dy = -4;
95:     else if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.dy = 4;
96:     else ship.dy = 0;
97:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - ship.h, ship.y + ship.dy));
98: 
99:     // move stars for parallax effect
100:     stars.forEach(s => {
101:       s.x -= s.speed;
102:       if (s.x < 0) { s.x = width; s.y = Math.random() * height; }
103:     });
104: 
105:     // move debris & asteroids leftwards
106:     debris.forEach(d => d.x -= d.speed);
107:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.x -= a.speed);
108: 
109:     // remove off‑screen objects
110:     while (debris.length && debris[0].x + debris[0].w < 0) debris.shift();
111:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].x + asteroids[0].w < 0) asteroids.shift();
112: 
113:     // collisions
114:     for (let i = debris.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:       if (rectsOverlap(ship, debris[i])) {
116:         score++; playSound(440, 0.2);
117:         debris.splice(i, 1);
118:       }
119:     }
120:     for (const a of asteroids) {
121:       if (rectsOverlap(ship, a)) {
122: gameOver = true; playSound(220, 0.5);
123:         break;
124:       }
125:     }
126: 
127:     // spawn new objects periodically
128:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnDebris();
129:     if (Math.random() < 0.01) spawnAsteroid();
130: 
131:     // timer
132:     timeLeft -= dt;
133:     if (timeLeft <= 0) gameOver = true;
134:   }
135: 
136:   function drawBackground() {
137:     // dark space gradient
138:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
139:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
140:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
141:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
142:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
143:     // stars
144:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
145:     stars.forEach(s => {
146:       ctx.beginPath();
147:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
148:       ctx.fill();
149:     });
150:   }
151: 
152:   function drawShip() {
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
154:     ctx.beginPath();
155:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
156:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
157:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
158:     ctx.closePath();
159:     ctx.fill();
160:   }
161: 
162:   function drawDebris(d) {
163:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2, 0, d.x + d.w / 2, d.y + d.h / 2, d.w / 2);
164:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#6f6');
165:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#060');
166:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
167:     ctx.fillRect(d.x, d.y, d.w, d.h);
168:   }
169: 
170:   function drawAsteroid(a) {
171:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
172:     ctx.beginPath();
173:     const cx = a.x + a.w / 2;
174:     const cy = a.y + a.h / 2;
175:     a.points.forEach((p, i) => {
176:       const px = cx + p.x;
177:       const py = cy + p.y;
178:       if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
179:       else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
180:     });
181:     ctx.closePath();
182:     ctx.fill();
183:   }
184: 
185:   function draw() {
186:     drawBackground();
187:     drawShip();
188:     debris.forEach(drawDebris);
189:     asteroids.forEach(drawAsteroid);
190:     // HUD
191:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
192:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
193:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
194:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
195:     ctx.textAlign = 'right';
196:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${Math.ceil(timeLeft)}`, width - 10, 20);
197:     if (gameOver) {
198:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
199:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
200:       ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
201:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
202:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
203:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2 - 20);
204:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
205:       ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, width / 2, height / 2 + 30);
206:     }
207:   }
208: 
209:   let lastTime = null;
210:   function loop(timestamp) {
211:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
212:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000; // seconds
213:     lastTime = timestamp;
214:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
215:     draw();
216:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
217:   }
218: 
219:   // start the game
220:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
221: })();

(End of file - total 221 lines)
